python3 <<'PY'
import os, re, zipfile
import xml.sax.saxutils as saxutils

SRC = 'quarterly_report.docx'
TMP = 'quarterly_report_outlined_tmp.docx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
doc = zin.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')

def para_text(p):
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t(?:\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</w:t>', p, flags=re.S)
    return saxutils.unescape(''.join(texts))

state = {'count': 0}

def underline_run(run):
    r = run.group(0)
    if '<w:u ' not in r:
        if '<w:rPr>' in r:
            r = r.replace('</w:rPr>', '<w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr>', 1)
        else:
            r = r.replace('<w:t', '<w:rPr><w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr><w:t', 1)
    return r

def process_para(m):
    p = m.group(0)
    txt = para_text(p).strip()
    upp = sum(1 for ch in txt if ch.isupper())
    low = any(ch.islower() for ch in txt)
    if upp >= 3 and not low:
        p = re.sub(r'<w:r(?:\s[^>]*)?>.*?</w:r>', underline_run, p, flags=re.S)
        state['count'] += 1
        print('Underlined: %r' % txt)
    return p

newdoc = re.sub(r'<w:p(?:\s[^>]*)?>.*?</w:p>', process_para, doc, flags=re.S)

zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w')
for item in zin.infolist():
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == 'word/document.xml':
        data = newdoc.encode('utf-8')
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()
os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('Headlines underlined:', state['count'])
PY

import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('quarterly_report.docx')
xml = z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')

# 1) well-formedness check
ET.fromstring(xml)
print('XML well-formed: OK')

# 2) underline count
print('w:u occurrences:', xml.count('<w:u w:val="single"/>'))

# 3) underline sample context
i = xml.find('<w:u w:val="single"/>')
seg = xml[max(0, i-160):i+80]
print('...', seg.replace('\n',' '), '...')

# 4) confirm no lowercase-only data rows were touched (they contain no underline)
for para in re.findall(r'<w:p(?:\s[^>]*)?>.*?</w:p>', xml, flags=re.S):
    txt = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', para)
    if txt.strip() and 'w:u' in para:
        print('Underlined paragraph text:', repr(txt.strip()[:60]))

# 5) zip integrity
print('Zip test:', z.testzip() is None)
print('Entry count:', len(z.infolist()))
